quotes: Nowhere can a man find a quieter retreat than in his own soul.||Marcus Aurelius
Quiet time alone lets your nervous system settle. Even five minutes counts.
You do not have to answer every thought that shows up.
Rest your attention somewhere gentle. Your breath works fine.
posts.caption:
Your quiet place goes with you. 🌙

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 4.3 (translations vary). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: A gift consists not in what is done or given, but in the intention of the giver.||Seneca
posts.caption:
It is the thought that counts. 🎁

Seneca, On Benefits 1.6 (translations vary).

quotes: The soft overcomes the hard; the gentle overcomes the rigid.||Lao Tzu
Being flexible under stress is a skill, not a weakness.
Kind self-talk is not weakness. It is what keeps you going.
Self-compassion helps people try again after a setback.
posts.caption:
Bend, do not break. 🌾

Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching ch. 78 (translations vary). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: Fine words without action are like a lovely flower with no scent.||Dhammapada
posts.caption:
